entities.name: The Ancestor
entities.description: Sky goddess worshiped by the Order and the nomads of the Daru Plains in Otaria, said to have created all life there.

entities.name: Daru Plains
entities.description: Plains of Otaria where nomads worship the Ancestor.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Land where the Ancestor is worshiped; destroyed in Karona's War.

entities.name: Eagle
entities.description: Animal spirit granted partial humanity by the Ancestor, creating the Aven.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Place to which Otarian refugees fled.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Figure of whom the Serran church holds the Ancestor to be an aspect.

entities.name: Serran church
entities.description: Church that adopted the doctrine that the Ancestor is an aspect of Serra.

entities.name: Reapportionment
entities.description: Time when the Ancestor granted Eagle partial humanity.

events.summary: In legend, the Ancestor grants Eagle partial humanity at the Reapportionment, creating the Aven.
events.quote: the Ancestor granted Eagle partial humanity, creating the Aven

events.summary: Otaria is destroyed in Karona's War and refugees carry Ancestor worship to Benalia.
events.quote: many Otarians, both aven and human, fled to Benalia, bringing their religious worship of the Ancestor with them

relations.quote: worshiped by The Order and the nomads of the Daru Plains in Otaria
